name: Patient Growth
outcome: Track the path from marketing inquiry to booking and attendance, and improve the clinic's new-patient flow.
guardrails: Do not promise more patients or revenue without evidence.
Ad spend is separate unless expressly included in a signed scope.
Do not infer marketing attribution when the source is missing.
Use only approved and lawful contact methods.
activation_requirements: Campaign analytics and event definitions agreed with the clinic.
Baseline and reporting window recorded before changes.
Measurement method and attribution limits disclosed.
